item.title: How We Finally Made Our Tiny Balcony A Proper Coffee Haven (Even With All The Rain)
item.description: Right, if you’re anything like us, living in a flat in a bustling UK city – let’s say, somewhere with tight staircases and a healthy dose of grey skies, like our little place in Manchester – you’ll know the struggle is real. Every square inch counts, and that often means any outdoor space, no matter how small, becomes a bit of a forgotten dumping ground. For us, it was our tiny balcony.
